[Intro: Quiet sung reprise over a soft pad, no drums]

metadata.tags: usa Rock alternative rock; fast, driving pulse with a half-time bridge and speedy two-bar outro; layered distorted-guitar overdubs, melodic bass, forceful drums, and a featured guitar solo; tightly layered production with doubled lead vocals; low, dark-register voice, hushed and close-mic in verses, clipped rhythmic staccato phrasing with whispered ad-libs between lines, building to gritty controlled belting in explosive choruses and a maximum-power final chorus, ending on a final guitar hit and cymbal crash.
